description:
We combine programming, creativity, and scientific curiosity to make SPHEREx data interactive and accessible. In 48 hours, we're ready to explore, innovate, and build something extraordinary.

Curiosity drives us. Space is the challenge.
summary: Aphelion Space Map is a website that provides fast and easy access to annual space data. In our project, we used satellite image data obtained from NASA’s SPHEREx telescope. We designed the site with overview, data exploration, image comparison, and candidate analysis screens. People who want to examine changes in space have to conduct long and continuous research to reach a result. This takes a lot of time. Our website shortens this period and makes research more efficient by allowing users to access the data they need from a single place. The project is aimed at scientists, space researchers, and space enthusiasts. It is important because it simplifies access to space data and accelerates the discovery process. In the future, we plan to improve the website, add more NASA datasets, and reach a wider audience with the project.
details:
APHELION SPACE MAP is a web-based platform that allows users to explore and analyze real NASA SPHEREx observations. By entering celestial coordinates (RA/Dec), users can retrieve astronomical images from the NASA/IPAC IRSA archive, view observation details, and compare observations of the same sky region taken at different times.

Our goal is to make astronomical data easier to access and help identify potential changes in the sky, including variable sources and moving-object candidates.

We developed the platform using Python, Flask, Astropy, NumPy, Requests, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Astropy handles FITS data and celestial coordinates, while NumPy supports scientific image processing.

Our innovative approach combines real archival data, spectral information, and time-based image comparison in one interactive platform. During development, we considered scientific accuracy, image alignment, spectral compatibility, data quality, and usability.
